thread:
alex: Morning — quick release train update for sprint 48. We're shipping a rapid runtime patch (runtime-v2.3.1) to address a decoding OOM in low-memory pods. Soft freeze on non-critical merges until Fri 18:00 UTC. Canary plan + rollback thresholds below.

maria: quick q — what counts as non-critical? docs or infra perf tweaks?

alex: non-critical = anything that can wait for next train (docs, dashboard cosmetics, non-security infra improvements). Security fixes and critical bugfixes still go through with expedited approvals.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime-v2.3.1 -> cluster/gamma-canary (start 1749999400). CI: all checks passed.

sam: canary started. first 50 requests look stable, latency +0.7ms, p95 unchanged.

kai: any changes to autoscaler or instance types? need to know for Dedicated capacity customers.

alex: no instance-type changes. autoscaler scaling window reduced to 30s for the canary window. If canary shows noise we pause and revert.

maria: what's the rollback threshold?

alex: rollback if error-rate > 1.5% over 5m AND p95 > baseline + 30ms. Also rollback if KV-cache miss rate spikes > 2x baseline.

devops-oncall: monitoring dashboards updated: /dashboards/release_train/s48-runtime-canary. Alerting rule created: rtc_runtime_canary_high_errors (severity: P2).

sam: small note — models using quantized kernels may emit a WARN during kernel warmup, it's expected; we'll watch for ERROR level entries.

alex: timeline: canary 1h, then gradual roll to 10% for 2h, 50% by EOD if clean. Soft freeze lifts Fri 18:00 UTC. Please block merges that are non-essential.

kai: ack. I'll notify Dedicated account owners to expect potential tail-latency checks.

maria: adding QA and prod-sig to canary watch channel.

release-bot: Deploy complete: runtime-v2.3.1 -> cluster/gamma-canary (end 1749999800).
